# Car Castle Goa - Self-Drive Car Rental Service in Goa, India

> Car Castle Goa is a trusted, government-compliant self-drive car rental agency based in Goa, India. We provide doorstep delivery across North Goa, South Goa, Dabolim Airport (GOI), Manohar International Airport Mopa (GOX), and all major railway stations (Madgaon and Thivim).

## Quick Facts
- **Business Name**: Car Castle Rentals Goa
- **Type**: Self-Drive Car Rental Agency
- **Operating Location**: Entire State of Goa, India
- **Headquarters / Hubs**: Panjim, Calangute, Dabolim Airport (GOI), Mopa Airport (GOX)
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 87672 86682
- **Website**: https://carcastlegoa.com
- **Operating Hours**: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (24/7)
- **Minimum Rental Duration**: 1 Day (24 hours)
- **Minimum Driving Age**: 21 years old
- **Documents Required**: Valid Original Driving License (Indian or International Driving Permit) + Aadhaar Card or Passport
- **Fuel Policy**: Level-to-level (Vehicle is provided with a set fuel level and returned with the same)
- **Kilometer Limit**: Unlimited kilometers across Goa state roads
- **Security Deposit**: ₹0 to ₹3,000 refundable security deposit (refunded upon vehicle inspection)

## Core Services
- [Self-Drive Car Rental](https://carcastlegoa.com/services/self-drive-car-rental-goa.html): Full freedom to drive anywhere within Goa.
- [Airport Car Rental Delivery](https://carcastlegoa.com/services/airport-car-rental-goa.html): Direct car delivery to Dabolim (GOI) and Mopa (GOX) terminals.
- [Monthly & Long-Term Car Rental](https://carcastlegoa.com/services/monthly-car-rental-goa.html): Discounted long stays for digital nomads and vacationers.

## Major Pickup Locations Served
- **Airports**: Dabolim Airport (GOI), Manohar International Airport, Mopa (GOX)
- **North Goa**: Panjim, Calangute, Baga, Candolim, Anjuna, Vagator, Morjim, Arambol, Thivim Railway Station
- **South Goa**: Margao / Madgaon Railway Station, Colva, Benaulim, Cavelossim, Palolem, Vasco da Gama

## Key Rental Policies
- **Insurance**: Comprehensive bumper-to-bumper commercial vehicle insurance included.
- **Roadside Assistance**: 24/7 breakdown support and replacement vehicle across all Goa routes.
- **Doorstep Handover**: Cars delivered directly to hotels, resorts, villas, and airport gates.
- **State Limits**: Vehicles permitted strictly within Goa state territory.
